info.title: Neighbor
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

attributes.description: Indicates any special attributes this Neighbor entry has.

from.description: 'dynamic': the neighbor was dynamically learnt. 'static' : the neighbor was statically configured. 'ivrl'   : the neighbor was added by inter VRF leaking. 'ipdb'   : the neighbor was added by ip directed broadcast. 'evpn-vtep' : the neighbor was added by EVPN for remote VTEP MAC-IP binding.

gbp_role_id.description: GBP role-id associated with neighbor entry. Non GBP clients use 0 as their role-id.

in_use_by_routes.description: When set to `true`, indicates this IP is used as a nexthop by one or more route entries.

ip_address.description:
Reference Resource: [Neighbor](#/Neighbor)
The IPv4 address or the IPv6 address of neighbor

l2_composite_group.description:
Reference Resource: [L2_Composite_Group](#/L2_Composite_Group)
L2 Composite Group corresponding to this Neighbor Entry. A L2 Composite Group is a composition of different types of l2 egress entities. For a Neighbor Entry, either 'tunnel_endpoint' or 'l2_composite_group' is populated to indicate how it is programmed in the forwarding plane.

last_updated.description: Time of the last update in seconds from epoch.

mac.description: MAC address learned for this neighbor.

multicast_l3_neighbor_forwarding.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding)
Multicast entry being used in case of IP directed broadcast.

phy_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Matches 'Port' if 'Port' refers to LAG/non-aggregated physical port, otherwise references the actual VLAN member port.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Neighbor](#/Neighbor)
Logical port LAG/non-aggregated physical port/L3 VLAN interface etc. at which MAC was learnt.

state.description: Current state of the neighbor entry.

tunnel_endpoint.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
In case of multipoint tunnels, like VXLAN, tunnel_endpoint designates specific endpoint where the packets matching this destination IP address should be forwarded to.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [Neighbor](#/Neighbor)
Reference to the VRF table, to which this neighbor belongs.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
